opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The Additional District Magistrate exercising the power of the Adjudicating Officer has imposed penalty upon the petitioner under Section 51 of the Act.
The consequential recovery is also under challenge.
It has not been disputed before us that against such an order, appeal would be maintainable before the Appellate Tribunal constituted under Section 70 of the Act.
